pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: crates/agent/src/main.rs:7 The binary entry point only parses arguments, loads config, and starts the loop, and each decision lives in a sibling module.

techniques.evidence: crates/agent/src/actions.rs:111 The cloud names an action type; workspace path resolution stays on the device, so callers do not learn the path rule.
crates/agent/src/exec.rs:5 Produce and deliver are split so the lease check in the runner is the only enabling point before the irreversible connector call.
crates/agent/src/connect.rs:38 Delivery matches an owned enum variant by name. A search of crates/agent for Deref and macro_rules found no implicit forwarding.
crates/agent/src/actions.rs:186 Prompt rendering is a function of the template and the task value; the tests pass constructed values and build no I/O doubles.
crates/agent/src/run.rs:2 Task runs stay serial because that is the rule; the heartbeat thread lives in the runner beside the blocking CLI call, and exec itself does not spawn.
crates/agent/src/inventory.rs:9 What the device can run changes with the action folders, so the advertised set is derived from those folders instead of a second list in config.
crates/agent/src/verdict.rs:9 Ownership is classified from the HTTP status and the typed body in one function, after a substring match on a formatted error had been the hatch.
crates/agent/src/actions.rs:266 Tests build RelayTask from JSON, so the input the logic reads already has a constructor and needs no host mirror.
crates/agent/src/run.rs:113 The renewal count is an Atomic shared by the heartbeat and the progress publisher, so the side thread does not write a copy that the join drops.
crates/agent/Cargo.toml:18 One blocking HTTP client. A search of crates/agent for wasm and cfg(target) found no second execution host.
crates/agent/src/exec.rs:7 The file records one finished split. A search of crates/agent for a cadence, a review-by date, or an emitted structural spec found none.
crates/agent/src/main.rs:3 This binary leases and runs relay tasks. Nothing in the crate selects structural candidates or grants standing approval over a structural pass.
crates/agent/src/run/tests.rs:8 The test pins one settlement decision. A search of crates/agent for benchmark and criterion found no harness over substitutable implementations.
crates/agent/src/cloud.rs:72 The workload in this crate is leasing tasks. No change-class replay or arm comparison is present.

pairs.registryProposal: The four process techniques (structural-improvement-loop, structure-is-not-delegable, scoreable-designs-are-built-not-argued, change-class-is-the-workload) have no residue in a runtime crate; grading their absence as a deviation makes every service fail the subject.

pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: clients/typescript/src/instrument.ts:27 Trace context is one process-global cell restored around sequential awaits, and concurrent callers are told to pass their own trace id, so the carrier concedes the parallel lane.

techniques.evidence: clients/typescript/src/instrument.ts:25 The span owned flag is a latch on that one cell. A search of clients/typescript for AsyncLocalStorage found no per-task carrier, and the next comment tells concurrent traces to work around the global.

clients/typescript/src/instrument.ts:234 wrap() probes three foreign client shapes with independent ifs, so a client that grows another SDK's method is also instrumented with that SDK's extractor. The probes are not an owned closed set.
clients/typescript/src/limits.ts:4 Reading a limit view is separated from the admission decision, so callers of admit learn the verdict and the header parsing stays in limits.ts.
clients/typescript/src/instrument.test.ts:26 Tests replace the send method and capture the event body, so the instrumentation path runs with no network. The same post method is the production door.
clients/typescript/src/admission.ts:154 admit decides from the cached view and an instant. The contract test passes nowMs, so the branch is reached without a fake clock or a fake socket.
clients/typescript/src/index.ts:674 The unsettled fetch stays inside post. guard, the extractors, and admit are synchronous, so the async model does not colour the decisions.
clients/typescript/src/pii.ts:6 The PII table is generated from the server scrubber, so a rule change has one source and the old hand-copied table is the drift they removed.
clients/typescript/src/index.ts:208 guard fills a violation list and a checks map in one pass, which is the multiple-outputs case where an explicit sequence is the form the technique requires.
clients/typescript/src/index.ts:340 The error body is accepted only after JSON.parse and a typeof check. A search of clients/typescript for eval and new Function found no dynamic execution hatch.
clients/typescript/src/instrument.test.ts:32 Tests hand the extractor a plain object, so the provider response is already constructible and no host mirror is required.

clients/typescript/src/contract.test.ts:46 renderPiiModule returns a complete module source string. The technique excludes a generator that writes a standalone file, because there is no caller scope to splice into.

clients/typescript/src/index.ts:6 Node and the browser are named as one fetch surface. journal.ts no-ops node:fs off Node. A search found no second timer or spawn implementation for hosts that disagree about those primitives.
clients/typescript/src/contract.test.ts:9 Shared fixtures pin behaviour across SDKs. A search of clients/typescript for a structural-pass cadence or an emitted spec found none.
clients/typescript/src/index.ts:3 This package is a telemetry client. Nothing in it selects structural candidates or holds a standing approval over a structural flow.
clients/typescript/src/instrument.test.ts:23 This helper captures events from one wrapped client. A search of clients/typescript for benchmark found no comparison of substitutable implementations.
clients/typescript/src/limits.ts:8 The fixtures pin parsing of fixed bytes. They do not replay a class of change against two structures.

pairs.registryProposal: state-carrier-decides-the-lane's tells are a cloned aggregate and an apology at a spawn site; a process-global async cell with the same concession is easy to leave unread, and the technique should name that carrier.
